propositions: LLMConfig.from_env discards region origin during CLI/env/config-file resolution, causing all configured regions to be mislabeled as region_source=REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION in provenance records

resolve_bedrock_region and provenance_for must label Bedrock region source truthfully: 'repo-config' for rebar.toml pins, 'cli' for CLI overrides, and existing env-var labels, without changing precedence

Region source metadata must be derived once during the single resolution pass and carried on LLMConfig.bedrock_region_source, then threaded to resolve_bedrock_region/provenance_for to ensure record and runtime cannot diverge
Resolution precedence must remain unchanged: CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > repo-config file > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION, with every source combination's precedence+label pair pinned in tests
Labeling is additive metadata only; resolved region value and all provider build paths must be byte-identical for identical inputs with no changes to existing wiring
Implementation must be portable with no CI-provider-specific triggers or environment-specific handling — pure in-process labeling
